name: mcp-botnex

tools.name: list_scans
tools.description: List the security scans owned by the authenticated user, including status (e.g. Running, Completed). Use this first when the user asks about scan history, progress, or to find a scan id.

tools.name: trigger_scan
tools.description: Start a new VAPT scan against a domain. 'scan_kind' selects a full security scan or asset discovery; 'scan_profile' controls depth. AI Agent Scan (scan_kind=agentic) cannot be started from MCP — use the BotNEX UI with a signed-in session. Returns the new scan id. Scans run asynchronously - poll list_scans for completion before fetching findings.

domain_name.description: Target domain without protocol, www, or URL paths. Examples: 'example.com', 'sub.example.com'. Do NOT include 'https://', 'www.', or path segments like '/our-services' — the scanner targets the domain itself, not a specific page URL.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key to safely retry without creating duplicate scans.

tools.name: get_scan_findings
tools.description: Fetch vulnerability findings for a scan, ordered by severity. Requires scan_id (UUID from list_scans). Optional page (default 1) and size (default 50, max 100). Use when scan status is Completed.

scan_id.description: Scan UUID from list_scans or trigger_scan.

tools.name: get_scan_summary
tools.description: Get an aggregated dashboard summary across the user's scans: total scans, severity breakdown, and overall risk. Use for a quick high-level overview rather than per-scan detail.

tools.name: list_scheduled_scans
tools.description: List upcoming scheduled scans that have not yet run for the authenticated user.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description:
Generate a downloadable report (PDF, CSV or DOCX) for a completed scan. This is a heavy operation; the report is produced on the backend. Returns confirmation and size — the binary file itself is not returned to the chat.

Optional content toggles (PDF only unless noted):
- include_ai_summary: include the AI scan-level executive summary section (default false; ignored when summary is not yet generated).
- include_ai_enrichment: include per-finding AI panels — exploit scenario, remediation steps, confidence (default false).
- include_asset_discovery: include the asset discovery inventory appendix (default true for asset_discovery / security_asset scans, false otherwise).

scan_id.description: The scan id to generate a report for.

include_ai_summary.description: Include AI scan-level executive summary in PDF.

include_ai_enrichment.description: Include per-finding AI enrichment panels in PDF/DOCX.

include_asset_discovery.description: Include asset discovery inventory appendix. Defaults to true for asset_discovery / security_asset scans.

tools.name: search_cves
tools.description: Search the CVE database across all fields with a free-text term (product name, keyword, technology). Use when the user mentions a vulnerability or software by name.

tools.name: get_cve_by_id
tools.description: Fetch full details for a specific CVE by its identifier (e.g. CVE-2021-44228), including CVSS score, description and affected products.
